parameters.note: How far back Progress's weight chart reads the 7-day average (K-979): twelve weeks (progress_grid_weeks, windows.yaml: the weeks the record is read over). The chart is drawn only from the points the server has in this window.

How many of the latest calls Progress's Calls card lists (K-979): twelve, one call a week over the same weeks (progress_grid_weeks, windows.yaml). The ledger screen is off the surface (ADR-069 #3), so Progress is where calls are read.

How many of the calls Progress lists open at first (K-1246, ADR-094 Ek 3 #7): the latest three; 'and N more' opens the rest of calls_shown in the same card, as the Train tab's today card does (Ek 2 › Uygulama #7).
